subtasks.title: Rewrite ScoutOpenOrderAddressesQuery to prune-first (approach B)

Keep open_hotlists/address_links CTEs, argMin/min direct-preference, argMax(_peerdb_version) coords, and geo/zero guards. Update the class docblock to document that IN is the PK prune and JOIN carries metadata — keep BOTH; never drop IN (approach A timed out). Pin semantics via existing ScoutRecordCheckInsCommandTest (extend only if a gap appears).
